plugins.name: Focus timer
plugins.description: A countdown timer in the top bar: click to start one (5, 15, 25 min or your own, with a label), right-click for finished timers. When one ends it notifies, plays an alarm and flashes.
plugins.author: gladimdim

plugins.name: Reminder
plugins.description: A bell in the top bar: click it to add a reminder, right-click it to see and remove them. When one is due it notifies, plays a ding-dong and the bell shakes.
plugins.author: gladimdim
